claim: Main-hand swing rate for a level-50 character at the haste cap is hm/(delay/10) x MH_CHAIN attempts per second.

inputs.name: haste cap
inputs.source: owner's character panel, 29 Aug 2026: base 100%, at cap 175%, Monk trio 185%

inputs.name: Monk Unbound Alacrity
inputs.source: same panel; corroborated by eqlwiki Game_Mechanics and an in-client AA string

inputs.name: multi-attack chain
inputs.source: 138 committed Legends client logs, timestamp-burst measurement (tools/multiattack.py)

assumptions.text: the character is at the haste cap
no movement or target-swapping inside the measured window

residual.note: jos437 slash 1.082/s predicted against 1.111/s measured over 395s engaged; punch -2.5%

stops: not claimed for bows or for the offhand
falsifier: Any logged 395s-or-longer engagement at the haste cap whose measured main-hand attempts per second differs from the predicted rate by more than 10%.
